name: adversarial-rise-review
statement: Run a dissenting Miadi review that compares prompts, provenance, implementation, rispecs, wiki targets, and intended STCKin/context-layer outcomes before approving revision or promotion.

name: artefacted-revision-report
statement: Write replayable adversarial review notes into the active artefact folder so later Miadi, RISE, and wiki waves can resume from concrete evidence instead of chat memory.

name: bounded-apt-release
statement: Close a bounded APT build/test/merge/publish mission without an open-ended review loop. Load for Debian package releases, focused re-review after a passing matrix, a user asking whether a release is finished, or scope narrowed to packaging only.

name: bundle-integration
statement: Integrate a Claude Design bundle into a target codebase — codify tokens into a rispec, convert design assets (e.g. mark.jsx) to static equivalents, stage prototypes under the codebase''s static-serving area, wire routes. Designed for early waves (tokens, hub + artifacts) where the work is single-lane.

name: chronicle-episode
statement: Stage, create, relate, and verify Chronicle episodes.

name: context-layer-promotion
statement: Evaluate reviewed Miadi material for promotion by separating provenance, spec, wiki, and context-layer concerns before drafting durable outputs.

name: deep-research-foundations
statement: Stewardship contract for creating and maintaining repository-local `foundations/<topic>/` packets: an opening statement of intent, academic grounding in parallel field lanes, a source ledger with verification states, gap analysis and synthesis, distributed in a package and related to what the packet grounds. Responsibilities are held by persona types with named capabilities, not by named agents.

name: editing-room
statement: Every medium of an episode in one Kdenlive project's bins, each labelled with its address and the first words said in it, takes from another host fetched when their sha256 matches, and the room sheet for the director. The timeline stays empty: the editor cuts.

name: fidelity-audit
statement: Two-stage audit — spec compliance first, code quality second. Required after every implementer task before a wave can close. Independent of self-claim. Includes a cheap post-wave audit pattern using a free model.

name: forge-wave-script
statement: Takes a WavePlan (from scan-and-plan or from user) and invokes Wave Script Forge to write a complete executable orchestration bash script, then verifies and reports it.

name: hermes-copilot-launch-preparation
statement: Prepare a Miadi Copilot wave as a machine-readable payload with exact plugin roster, lane contracts, validation scripts, transcript audit hooks, recovery prompt, and closure gate.

name: hermes-copilot-wave-closure
statement: Close a completed Miadi Copilot/Hermes wave by auditing transcript evidence, changed files, validation, commit partitioning, Chronicle impact, and follow-up trigger decisions.

name: in-the-program
statement: An agent works in Kdenlive on the person's own display while they watch: finds the episode's film projects, opens one, shows it, plays it, walks its guides and checks the sound by Kdenlive's action names, saves or reloads only when the person asks, and logs every act, improvised ones included.

achieves.statement: A person sees what an agent prepared in the program where they will choose, and stays the one who chooses.

name: miadi-closeout-handoff
statement: Use when closing a Miadi Codex session, wave, research pass, or plugin-building task. Verifies planned work, updates source-ledger status, records gaps, and writes a replayable handoff.

name: miadi-gemini-session-prep
statement: Prepare a reliable Miadi Gemini CLI orchestration session with charter, source ledger, extension recommendations, replayable launch script, and compact attention-only reporting.

name: miadi-mightyeagle-issue-263
statement: Use this skill for jgwill/Miadi#263 security-remediation orchestration work: resume from the live issue workspace, revise the issue-263-derived rispecs, and run explicit implementer/review/promotion handoffs without creating a new plugin.

name: miadi-mino-tmux-inventory
statement: Keep the session inventory. For a tmux session William names, find its session id (from its binding line, or /exit or /status), read what it did, and write one JSON record in ~/workspace/.mino/session-inventory/ following SCHEMA.md there, closed or ongoing

name: miadi-rise-wave-plan
statement: Use when a Miadi mission is ready to be decomposed into RISE-aligned execution waves with scope, evidence roots, write boundaries, acceptance gates, and handoff artifacts.

name: miadi-rispec-readiness-review
statement: Use when deciding whether a Miadi rispec, future plugin idea, or draft orchestration pattern is ready to become a Codex or Copilot plugin. Produces a readiness decision without scaffolding or promoting the plugin.

name: miadi-session-bootstrap
statement: Use when starting a Miadi Codex orchestration session from a raw user prompt, mission brief, transcript excerpt, or workspace context. Produces a session charter, artifact folder, initial source ledger, and optional RISE wave-plan stub.

name: miadi-source-ledger
statement: Use when claims, context, rispec decisions, memory candidates, plugin-readiness decisions, or synthesis outputs need explicit source evidence, confidence, contradiction status, and promotion state.

name: model-routing-policy-simulator
statement: Generate an OpenClaw model-routing matrix from task, risk, context, tool, cost, latency, memory, confidence, and review inputs.

name: openclaw-model-routing-bootstrap
statement: Bootstrap the OpenClaw model-routing study by reading fixed-order context, validating or creating the launch manifest, enforcing write scopes, token caps, issue links, and stop conditions.

name: openclaw-plugin-gap-contracts
statement: Reconcile OpenClaw study plugin gap names and contracts while keeping live connector implementation out of read-only research phases.

name: openclaw-rise-rispec-scaffold
statement: Scaffold OpenClaw model-routing rispecs using Reverse-engineer -> Intent-extract -> Specify -> Export and the standard 6-file rispec packet shape.

name: openclaw-source-ledger
statement: Maintain OpenClaw study source ledgers with evidence types, evidence quality, contradiction handling, and strict claim-to-source rules.

name: outcome-drift-audit
statement: Audit Miadi work against explicit STCKin and context-layer outcomes so plausible scaffolds do not pass as successful delivery.

name: plan-critic
statement: Independent one-pass findings on Miette's plan insight: fidelity to plan/person, recommendation, affected people, unsupported claims and plain form. Give a separate subagent all three inputs; no file access is needed.

name: production-context-exploration
statement: Explore a potential Chronicle before choosing an episode.

name: promotion-decision-record
statement: Write an artefact-friendly markdown record of Miadi promotion decisions so later RISE and wiki waves can resume from explicit layer choices and blockers.

name: resume-wave-prep
statement: Resumes an interrupted wave-forge preparation from prior artefacts. Reads existing WavePlan, review result, and generated script to determine where to continue: at review, replan, or reforge.

name: review-plan
statement: Full plan-review cycle: read a proposed/ file, run 5-point gap analysis, create or update the jgwill/src tracking issue, output revision prompt. Use when the user says "review the plan", "check the proposal", or when a new proposed/ file has landed and needs analysis before the implementing agent gets the next prompt.

name: review-wave-plan
statement: Adversarial review of a WavePlan before forging. Checks agent validity, path existence, desire alignment, and structural completeness. Returns ADVANCE or REVISE with specifics.

name: scan-and-plan
statement: Orchestrates the full scan → plan flow: invokes Orchestration Context Scanner on all target directories and plugin sources, then invokes Orchestration Wave Planner to produce a WavePlan.

name: scenes-to-timeline
statement: A video cut into its scenes on a Kdenlive stringout, in order, with black between them, an empty music track and a guide at each black, checked through melt and in Kdenlive on a hidden display.

name: screen-implementer
statement: Reimplement ONE screen from a design bundle as production code in the target codebase''s stack. Visual fidelity to the prototype, but native to the target. Designed for delegated waves where each screen is a subordinate lane handled by a fresh task agent.

name: stckin-artefact-report
statement: Write replayable findings and next-wave notes into the active Miadi deep-search artefact folder after an orchestration or STCKin work session.

name: stckin-orchestration-scaffold
statement: Scaffold or refine a Miadi-native Copilot orchestration kit by adapting source plugin patterns to STCKin, deep-search, and artefacted session work.

name: stckin-wave-bootstrap
statement: Bootstrap Miadi STCKin and orchestration-kit work by studying mia-awesome-copilot, Miadi STC hooks, and prior deep-search artefacts before editing.

name: storyweaver-brief-intake
statement: Extract a story or Chronicle request into creative brief, constraints, protocol flags, and human questions while preserving the original prompt.

name: storyweaver-chapter-wave
statement: Draft one or more chapters, scenes, beats, or sections from accepted contracts, then route through continuity, developmental review, critique, and revision.

name: storyweaver-continuity-ledger
statement: Update facts, changed facts, timelines, character state, relationship state, world rules, source-dependent details, promises, and export blockers.

name: storyweaver-cultural-protocol-check
statement: Review sensitive material for consent, authority, privacy, cultural protocol, canon uncertainty, and route decisions before drafting or export.

name: storyweaver-export-packet
statement: Assemble final or provisional story packets with manuscript, metadata, source ledger, continuity, reviews, revision dossier, closure note, and next commissions.

name: storyweaver-foundations-bridge
statement: Bridge academic or infrastructure research into source-led foundations packets, Chronicle seeds, story source ledgers, and audience-layer notes.

name: storyweaver-outline-and-beats
statement: Create outline, beat map, chapter or scene contracts, and an outline review route from the accepted story bible.

name: storyweaver-review-loop
statement: Run developmental, critique, continuity, and protocol review on a story or Chronicle artefact and produce a route decision.

name: storyweaver-session-bootstrap
statement: Start or resume a Miadi Storyweaver workspace with session charter, state manifest, artefact index, delegation map, and next-skill route.

name: storyweaver-session-to-episode
statement: Convert a meaningful real agent, research, infrastructure, or creative session into a source-led Miadi Chronicle episode packet without fictionalizing facts.

name: storyweaver-story-bible
statement: Build a stable story bible, character arcs, relationship map, motifs, world rules, and first continuity ledger from an accepted brief.

name: storyweaver-storyforms-and-beats
statement: Extract StoryForms, StoryBeats, Story Setting, related work, and follow-up commissions from sessions, episodes, chapters, or Chronicle packets.

name: storyweaver-visual-chronicle-seed
statement: Create visual Chronicle prompt packets, exclusions, reference-image notes, generation notes, and archive placement guidance without generating images.

name: storyweaver-voice-episode-packet
statement: Prepare voice episode files: script.md, narration.txt, revision-notes.md, episode.yaml, source context, index-update guidance, and split/recovery notes.

name: two-eyed-translator
statement: Rewrites a correct but unreceivable AI output into one a human can act on, holding both eyes on the same object. Use when a reader cannot comprehend an answer's value, the Two-Eyed balance hook blocks, or someone asks to translate, shorten, humanize, or decolonize the last answer.

name: wiki-promotion-draft
statement: Draft Miadi wiki updates from already-reviewed material while preserving provenance, spec, and context-layer boundaries.

name: youtube-source
statement: Use when a YouTube source needs transcript or duration evidence.

name: mia-episode-companion
statement: Listens for a new episode take, grounds Mia's reply in the transcript and episode, and returns the reply to the phone.

name: miadi-film
statement: Prepares an episode's editing room and helps a person review a proposed cut on the desktop timeline.

name: mia-episode-companion/close-screenwalk
statement: Close the screenwalk being recorded with its last message, which is also its title, description and introduction

name: mia-episode-companion/mia-listen
statement: Listen for the person's next voice take in this episode and answer as Mia

name: miadi-film/editing-room
statement: Prepare an episode's editing room as the assistant editor - every medium in Kdenlive bins with its address and first words, takes fetched from the recording host, the room sheet, checked in Kdenlive

name: miadi-film/in-the-program
statement: Open an episode's film project on the person's display and show it to them (the newest, or the one named), then play it or walk its guides on their word

name: miadi-film/scenes-timeline
statement: Cut an episode's videos (its Deep Diver explainers, unless named) into scenes and lay them on a Kdenlive timeline with black between them, then check it through melt and in Kdenlive

name: mia-episode-companion/SessionStart
statement: Handles the SessionStart event for mia-episode-companion.

name: miadi-film/PostToolUse
statement: Handles the PostToolUse event for miadi-film.
